correctness.rationale: The normalized creation-annihilation commutation relations yield L_n=(I+nR_n)/(n+1) exactly. The Gram factorization R_n=V_n V_n^*/n, with V_n^*V_n=(n+d-1)I, determines every eigenvalue and multiplicity for every n,d. Positive/negative monotonicity, binomial cumulative counts and degreewise decay prove the indexed asymptotics, compactness, ideal thresholds and exact harmonic logarithmic limits. The included checker directly constructs finite block matrices and passed 1012 assertions. The infinite result depends on the analytic proof, not that finite test.

value.rationale: A natural qualitative semi-hyponormality counterexample for a canonical universal shift is resolved by a complete invariant: its exact compact indefinite spectrum, dimension-dependent multiplicities and two distinct sharp positive/negative Schatten thresholds. The difference of the optimal decay orders is significant for nonlinear operator inequalities, with precise logarithmic endpoints enabling spectral comparison with other Hilbert-module compressions.
